strings: When r_c0 comes over to check m_c after complaints of tingling in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} legs, it's to inform {PRONOUN/m_c/object} that it's because {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} legs aren't working properly anymore.

m_c has been complaining of tingling in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} legs for days, but one day it stops. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} {VERB/m_c/are/is} relieved, until {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/try/tries} to move again.
When m_c attempts to get up from {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} nest, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/let/lets} out a yowl of distress. It would appear that only half of {PRONOUN/m_c/object} has gotten up.
After a few moons of on and off falling over, m_c finds one morning that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} no longer {VERB/m_c/have/has} to worry about falling.
